card.name: Start of a sentence: Experience with
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "Experience" or "experience" opening a sentence about clinical experience with a drug, often after a heading. It also fires on a few other word starts such as "Cond" in condensation.

modes.label: Experience with a drug
modes.description: The word experience starting a statement about how much is known from use of the drug in a group.
modes.example: Use in Pregnancy<< Experience>> with this drug in pregnant women is inadequate

modes.label: Other sentence-start words
modes.description: Scattered word starts after a sentence or heading, such as Cond in condensation or a name.
modes.example: DO NOT thaw using a heat source such as a microwave or hot water.<< Cond>>ensation is normal after thawing.
